Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner wrongly conflated two different women named “Julia Caesaris.” Marcus Atius Balbus was the husband of Julia (Caesar’s sister, often called Julia Minor), not Julia the daughter of Julius Caesar and Cornelia. By introducing Balbus as an alternative “child-in-law” and proposing an “earliest-attested-record” preference, the Planner misidentified Cornelia’s child-in-law. Cornelia’s only child, Julia, married Pompey the Great, making Pompey (not Balbus) the sole correct child-in-law.
